id: 12_Laboratory Safety Comprehensive Electrical Hazard Awareness Training Course
title: 电气危害：认得清，躲得开
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/12_Laboratory Safety Comprehensive Electrical Hazard Awareness Training Course.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/12_Laboratory Safety Comprehensive Electrical Hazard Awareness Training Course/src.py

points.K7: 专业人员和普通人员分工
points.S3: 有人触电：先断电再施救

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有几台仪器和插线板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with several instruments and a power strip, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：认清电气危害。
overlay: 电气危害：认得清，躲得开

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一台仪器，电线外皮有裂口，他没注意
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a small instrument whose power cord has a cracked insulation spot he does not notice.
shots.narration: 阿杰要插电，没看见电线外皮破了。

shots.scene: 小研一把按住他的手，指着破口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops his hand before he plugs in and points at the damaged cord.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧拦住：电，可不能大意。

shots.scene: 触电图标和受伤的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: An electric shock warning sign next to an injured person icon with a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 电伤害往往很重，致残致死的都不少。

shots.scene: 日历翻页，每页都有一个闪电警示
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flipping, each page marked with a small lightning warning symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 每年都有人因为触电丢了性命。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训教室讲课，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a training class in front of a blank screen; the young male student listens.
shots.narration: 单位要组织用电安全培训。

shots.scene: 触电、电击、电弧、爆炸、火灾五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a lightning bolt with a person, a shock symbol, an arc flash, an explosion and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 防触电、电击、电弧、爆炸和火灾。

shots.scene: 放大镜照着电线和插座
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon over a power cord and a wall outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 培训的目的：会识别电气危害，

shots.scene: 人形图标绕开闪电区域走
shots.prompt_en: A person icon walking around a zone marked with a lightning bolt, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 还要会主动避开它。

shots.scene: 检查、安装、操作、维护四个图标连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Four icons connected in a circle: a magnifying glass, a wrench, a power button and an oil can. No people.
shots.narration: 从检查、安装，到使用、维护，都有标准。

shots.scene: 一摞空白标准文本
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank standard booklets with a national emblem-free seal. No people.
shots.narration: 国家有电气安全标准，

shots.scene: 标准文本旁出现勾选清单
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with green checks appearing beside the booklets. No people.
shots.narration: 规定了该怎么做、按什么程序做。

shots.section_title: 专业人员和普通人员分工
shots.scene: 持证电工和普通实验人员两个人形，各有不同工具
shots.prompt_en: Two person icons: an electrician with a tool bag and a certificate, and a lab worker with a pipette. No people.
shots.narration: 专业电工和普通人员，要求不一样。
overlay: 专业人员和普通人员分工

shots.section_title: 专业人员和普通人员分工
shots.scene: 老李打开配电箱，小研在旁边只负责报修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens an electrical panel while the female graduate student stands back holding a phone.
shots.narration: 电工修线路，我们只管正确使用和报修。

shots.scene: 图纸、安装、扳手三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blueprint, an installation tool and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 电气系统的设计、安装和维护，

shots.scene: 规范文本盖在图纸上，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard booklet placed on a blueprint with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 都要按规范来，不能凭感觉。

shots.scene: 电弧闪光图标
shots.prompt_en: An arc flash icon bursting from a switch box. No people.
shots.narration: 电气安全的重点：一防电弧，

shots.scene: 电流穿过人体的示意图被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of current passing through a person's body from hand to foot, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 二防电击。

shots.scene: 小研检查电线、插头，发现破皮和焦痕
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inspects a power cord and plug and finds cracked insulation and a scorch mark.
shots.narration: 用电前，看电线、看插头。

shots.scene: 破皮、发热、焦味三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a cracked cord, a hot plug with heat lines, and a smoke wisp. No people.
shots.narration: 破皮、发烫、有焦味，立即停用。

shots.scene: 仪器挂上空白停用牌，阿杰打电话报修
shots.prompt_en: An instrument with a blank out-of-service tag; the young male student calls for repair on the phone.
shots.narration: 挂牌停用，找人维修，不自己缠胶布。

shots.scene: 下班时小研关掉仪器开关、拔下插头
shots.prompt_en: At the end of the day the female graduate student switches off instruments and unplugs them.
shots.narration: 离开实验室，关掉不用的电器。

shots.scene: 需要过夜运行的仪器旁挂着空白登记卡
shots.prompt_en: An instrument left running overnight with a blank registration card hanging on it. No people.
shots.narration: 要长时间运行的，按规定登记、有人巡查。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 有人触电倒地的图标，旁边一只手伸过去被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person collapsed next to an appliance, with a bare hand reaching toward them crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 看到有人触电，千万别直接用手拉！
overlay: 有人触电：先断电再施救

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 小研冲向配电箱拉下开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rushes to the electrical panel and switches off the breaker.
shots.narration: 第一步，马上切断电源。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电再施救
shots.scene: 干燥木棍挑开电线的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dry wooden stick pushing a power cord away from a person icon. No people.
shots.narration: 断不了电，用干燥木棍等绝缘物挑开。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有120
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 立即拨打120。

shots.scene: 受过培训的王老师跪地施救，旁边有自动体外除颤器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator, trained in first aid, kneels to help a collapsed person, with an automated external defibrillator box nearby.
shots.narration: 受过培训的人进行心肺复苏。

shots.scene: 医院图标，旁边是报告链图标：实验室—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: A hospital icon, next to a chain of icons connected by arrows: a lab, a college building and a security badge. No people.
shots.narration: 看着没事也要就医，并报告负责人。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现五种电气伤害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a shock symbol, an arc flash, an explosion and a flame.
shots.narration: 电伤害很重，要会识别、会避开。

shots.scene: 插头检查、关电源两个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green checks: a plug under a magnifying glass, and a power switch turned off. No people.
shots.narration: 用前查电线，人走就断电。

shots.scene: 断电开关、木棍、120电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a breaker switched off, a dry wooden stick and a telephone with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 有人触电先断电，再呼救施救。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个插头竖起大拇指，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a healthy plug, gives a thumbs-up and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 认得清，躲得开，下次见！
